Source/reviewer runs must match their actual company/child; a non-null creator or reviewer Agent must match the corresponding run. A null historical/system creator is not upgraded into an Agent identity.

The original native tool uses its bound current run/Agent/DB Human reader. Missing/unmatched/unreadable receiver remains public-only. Context claims, task ownership and latest-run inference supply no private authority; no synthetic run is created for preflight.

The final two native caller variants also test no-run preflight with forged context identity hints, a real explicit sharing row and subsequent revocation, wrong reviewer-Task binding, and mismatched source creator Agent. Their source/result/assessment/decision rows are structurally native consumer projection fixtures with real FK ownership, not provider-success or complete-input proof. Final56 cases across native privacy, existing continuation and existing tool authority suites pass; server compilation passes. The compiler first caught an incomplete request-confirmation fixture payload; it was corrected to the existing version1/prompt contract without weakening assertions.
